name: Debt Advice Foundation
notes: We are a national debt advice charity offering free, confidential support and advice to anyone worried about debt.  When you contact us, you will be assigned a qualified debt adviser, who will immediately start helping you to reduce monthly payments to an affordable level, stop creditors taking enforcement action against you and protect important assets such as your home.
